title: A single bottom differential is split injective from residue exactness
statement: Let R be a commutative ring and P a cochain complex of R-modules indexed by the integers. Let a be an integer. Suppose P^(a-1) is zero, and P^a and P^(a+1) are finite projective R-modules [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex]. Suppose that for every prime ideal p, termwise extension of scalars to the residue field kappa(p) has zero homology in degree a. Then d:P^a -> P^(a+1) is injective, and the canonical opcycles in degree a+1, namely coker(d), is projective over R. No boundedness or hypotheses on other terms or other homology groups are imposed.

source.place: Tag 00O0, Algebra Lemma cokernel-flat (1), applied on all of Spec R; Tag 00NX, finite projectivity

proof.text: Extension of scalars takes the zero term P^(a-1) to zero. The residue homology hypothesis therefore says that the base change of d(a,a+1) is injective at each prime: with zero incoming differential, zero homology is equivalent to monicity of the outgoing map. Identify categorical monicity of a module map with injectivity of its underlying linear map.

Apply Module.finiteProjectiveCokernel_residue_localization at every prime to the two finite projective terms and their proved fibre injectivity. This yields a principal neighborhood with injective map and projective quotient at each prime. The target term is finitely presented by Module.finitePresentation_of_projective. Apply the principal-cover descent lemma to obtain injectivity and projectivity of the global range quotient.

The canonical abstract opcycles in degree a+1 are isomorphic to the quotient of P^(a+1) by the range of d(a,a+1), by the ModuleCat cokernel isomorphism. Transfer projectivity along this linear equivalence; transfer injectivity to Mono d. The construction involves no arbitrary data chosen from an unproved existence theorem.

proof_origin.place: Tag 00O0 and 00NX, with Mathlib ShortComplex exactness and opcycles isomorphisms; principal-cover descent isolated as a single remaining theorem.

theorem residue_bottom_differential
    (R : Type v) [CommRing R]
    (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{v} R) ℤ) (a : ℤ)
    (hz : IsZero (P.X (a - 1)))
    (hf₀ : Module.Finite R (P.X a))
    (hf₁ : Module.Finite R (P.X (a + 1)))
    (hp₀ : Module.Projective R (P.X a))
    (hp₁ : Module.Projective R (P.X (a + 1)))
    (hresidue : ∀ (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime],
      let Pp := ((ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap R p.ResidueField)).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)).obj P
      IsZero (Pp.homology a)) :
    Mono (P.d a (a + 1)) ∧ Module.Projective R (P.opcycles (a + 1))
